title: Mountain Sewer
subtitle: Ancient Arbalest near the bottom
steps: In the Facility Hub, ask the Warden about the Mountain Sewer (level 30+).
Take the Mountain Sewer portal (near Tou-Tou).
Descend and find the Ancient Arbalest.
Show it to the Warden for the reward.

notes.title: Quest item
notes.body: The Ancient Arbalest is placed in the data, so the route goes straight to it.

notes.title: Locked doors
notes.body: Several doors on the way down need a master key. The route is built from the open ones, so check it in game.

notes.title: Zefirs
notes.body: Zefirs cast War Magic. Use the sewer walls to block line of sight. They take slightly less than full damage from fire (0.6) and electric (0.65).

notes.title: Lich Lord
notes.body: One Lich Lord (level 60) is in the sewer. It takes cold at 0.2.
